title: Busiest weekday
statementMd:
Which weekday (0 = Sunday) has the most loans started? Show weekday and count; there is no tie.

Expected columns: `weekday`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%w', loan_date) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loans GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY loans DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
